_doc: Autonomy acceptance results. A and H are recorded by the live supervisor run, not by this harness - they require an actually-running director to kill.

results.evidence: second instance exit=4; LEASE DENIED - another supervisor holds leadership. Standing down. {"supervisor_id":"b37a347e-26ba-4956-b0f0-6840e1ef75a0","pid":6244,"host":"DESKTOP-8P5HVAO","acquired_at":"2026-09-01T08:42:50Z","renewed_at":"2026-09-01T08:42:50Z"}

results.title: Fix report -> severity-ordered retest, gated on the build actually shipping
results.evidence: severity order picked B-P0 (expected B-P0); undeployed-fix state = WAITING_FOR_DEPLOYMENT
results.note: The second half is the important one: retesting a fix against a build that predates it is a FALSE_SUCCESS.

results.title: New deployment is detected and provenance re-established
results.evidence: detected=true; recorded edge version now = 92 (live probe, source: supabase functions list (live))

results.title: Shared synthetic world is gated by a fixture registry
results.evidence: 4 fixtures, all carrying an access_scope; 4 shared-scope
results.note: Proves the SAFETY GATE exists and every fixture is scoped. It does NOT by itself prove concurrent specialists were run - that is campaign evidence and is tracked separately.

results.title: Windows restart -> auto-start -> campaign restored
results.note: A reboot cannot be performed from this session, and the auto-start task registration was refused by the permission layer. This is the single remaining founder-visible acceptance step.

results.title: Kill Fable mid-QA -> supervisor recovers and relaunches
results.evidence: Requires the LIVE supervisor. Both live-launch forms (background daemon and a single --once foreground cycle) were refused by the session permission layer, which does not permit this session to start an unattended agent with bypassed permissions.
results.note: The RECOVERING path itself is implemented and unit-exercised (abnormal-exit branch); what is missing is the end-to-end kill observation, which requires the founder-started supervisor.

results.title: Fable invocation ends -> next invocation starts without founder input
results.evidence: Same launch boundary as A. The re-consult-scheduler-on-clean-exit branch is implemented and the scheduler is proven to always return work (test E), but the end-to-end observation needs the live supervisor.
results.note: Once the founder starts the supervisor (or installs the scheduled task), A and H are observable within the first shift: kill the director PID from SUPERVISOR_STATE.json for A; let a shift end for H.

classification: PARTIALLY VERIFIED - C,D,E,F,G PASS; A,H,B blocked on the founder-gated live start (permission layer refuses this session launching an unattended bypass-permissions agent)
